entities.name: Fall of Arathoxia
entities.description: Autumn 4195 AR destruction of the city of Arathoxia by the planeswalker Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought absolute rule over Corondor and destroyed Arathoxia.

entities.name: Arathoxia
entities.description: City of Corondor ruled by a Grand Sultan and five houses.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Region Ravidel sought to rule.

entities.name: Grand Sultan of Arathoxia
entities.description: Leader of Arathoxia who refused Ravidel and survived its fall.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Teenaged survivor of Arathoxia who swore vengeance on Ravidel.

entities.name: Lady Verdenth
entities.description: Head of House Verdenth, mistress of Krysalthus Forest, killed by Ravidel; had spared Jared as an infant.

entities.name: Tobias Kavrel
entities.description: Head of House Kavrel.

entities.name: Marshal Bikov
entities.description: Head of House Bikov.

entities.name: Lord of House Khone
entities.description: Enigmatic head of House Khone who survived.

entities.name: Scarlet Vizier
entities.description: Caught between loyalties, executed by Ravidel; may have played a role in Jared's mother's death.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Shapeshifter connected to Jared's past who locked him in a cage and survived the fall.

entities.name: Yorgo
entities.description: Former tormentor of Jared turned ally, later a bandit in the ruins.

entities.name: Nikko
entities.description: Former tormentor of Jared turned ally.

entities.name: Ezer
entities.description: Old spellsquire stuck in a hospice behind scathe zombies, rescued by Jared.

entities.name: House Verdenth
entities.description: Non-red house of Arathoxia, destroyed with its emerald tower.

entities.name: House Kavrel
entities.description: Non-red house of Arathoxia whose Watchtower was toppled by demons.

entities.name: House Bikov
entities.description: Non-red house whose sapphire manse was obliterated by a Chaos Orb.

entities.name: House Khone
entities.description: Non-red house of Arathoxia.

entities.name: Black Fortress
entities.description: The last house destroyed by Ravidel.

events.summary: Ravidel attacks Arathoxia after the Grand Sultan refuses to submit, aiming to annihilate his enemies including Jared.
events.quote: When the city's leader, the Grand Sultan of Arathoxia , refused to submit to the planeswalker 's demands, Ravidel chose to annihilate the city

events.summary: The four non-red houses resist but fall in rapid succession as Ravidel's juggernauts and demons overrun them.
events.quote: His juggernauts smashed the city gates, and his demonic hordes overran their defenses.

events.summary: Lady Verdenth dies and her emerald tower is destroyed; Ravidel executes the Scarlet Vizier for perceived betrayal.
events.quote: The Scarlet Vizier , caught between loyalties, was executed by Ravidel for his perceived betrayal

events.summary: Jared allies with Yorgo and Nikko, learns of Liana of Minorad from the dying vizier, and rescues Ezer from scathe zombies.
events.quote: Jared and his team of urchins killed the undead and rescued the old spellsquire

events.summary: Liana of Minorad intervenes in Jared's near-duel with Ravidel and cages him while Ravidel destroys the sultan's palace.
events.quote: Liana of Minorad intervened in the near-duel, locking Jared away in a cage while Ravidel went on to destroy the sultan's palace.

events.summary: Arathoxia is left a ruin; the sultan, the Lord of House Khone, Jared and Liana escape, and Jared swears vengeance on Ravidel.
events.quote: Jared swore vengeance against Ravidel, seeking retribution for the loss of his parents and his shattered home.

relations.note: sought to eliminate him; Jared swore vengeance
relations.quote: aiming to eliminate all his enemies in one fell swoop, including the teenaged Jared Carthalion
The Scarlet Vizier , caught between loyalties, was executed by Ravidel for his perceived betrayal
Jared joined forces with Yorgo and Nikko , former tormentors turned allies, to save innocent lives.
